title: Men are losing ground in the labor market. Here's why
snippet: Women outnumbered men in the workforce for eight straight months as of September, according to one analysis.

title: Rivian tops Q3 delivery expectations, reconfirms 2026 guidance
snippet: Rivian reported a year-over-year increase in vehicle deliveries of 46% during the third quarter.

title: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
snippet: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.

title: Accenture stock rallies after earnings beat expectations
snippet: Shares of Accenture surged Thursday after the company's fiscal fourth-quarter results beat estimates.

title: Nike shares drop as retailer posts disappointing sales, announces layoffs as part of restructuring
snippet: Nike is expected to post another quarter of declining sales as the company tries to turn around its business and regain growth in China.

title: Micron beats on earnings and issues strong guidance as data center revenue jumps 11-fold
snippet: Micron is up over 500% in the past year as the company benefits from soaring AI demand.

title: We're raising our Micron price target after an incredible quarter and robust guidance
snippet: Micron signaled that fiscal 2027 will be another strong year as demand for its memory products continues to exceed supply.

title: Costco makes progress on a key membership metric. Here's our new price target on the stock
snippet: Costco's membership renewal rates moved in the right direction. But the debate isn't totally settled just yet.

title: Darden Restaurants stock falls as Olive Garden reports slower growth
snippet: Olive Garden's same-store sales growth has slowed in recent quarters.

title: Salesforce issues revenue target of over $63 billion for fiscal 2030, beating estimates
snippet: Salesforce issued some updated longer-term financials at its annual Dreamforce conference.

title: J.B. Hunt stock plunges 13% after company warns third-quarter earnings will fall
snippet: Shares of J.B. Hunt plunged 13% Wednesday after the company warned of an earnings drop between 5% and 10%.
